using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Cluster.Tests
{
    public class ClusterManagerSlotStateTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ClusterManager>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly ClusterManager _clusterManager;

        public ClusterManagerSlotStateTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterManager>>();
            // Create a minimal ClusterManager instance with mocked logger
            // Note: This assumes ClusterManager has a constructor or factory that accepts ILogger
            // For testing the specific LogTrace call, we focus on the execution path reaching line 401
            _clusterManager = CreateClusterManagerWithLogger(_loggerMock.Object);
        }

        private ClusterManager CreateClusterManagerWithLogger(ILogger<ClusterManager> logger)
        {
            // This would typically use a test constructor or factory.
            // For demonstration, assuming a constructor exists or can be made accessible.
            // In practice, this might require apply_refactor if no suitable constructor exists.
            throw new NotImplementedException("Requires test-specific constructor or refactor");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TrySetSlotStable_WhenRemoteNode_SetsSlotStableAndLogsTrace()
        {
            // Arrange
            var slot = 123;
            var nodeid = "remote-node-1";
            ReadOnlySpan<byte> errorMessage;

            // Mock currentConfig to return non-local workerId > 0 for nodeid
            // Simulate the execution path that reaches the else block (line 401)

            // Act
            var result = _clusterManager.TrySetSlotStable(slot, nodeid, out errorMessage);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    0,
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ContainsMessage(v, $"[Processed] SetSlot {slot} FORCED TO {nodeid}")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TrySetSlotStable_WhenLocalNode_BumpsEpochAndLogsDebugNotTrace()
        {
            // Arrange
            var slot = 456;
            var nodeid = "local-node"; // Matches CurrentConfig.LocalNodeId
            ReadOnlySpan<byte> errorMessage;

            // Act
            var result = _clusterManager.TrySetSlotStable(slot, nodeid, out errorMessage);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.Log(LogLevel.Debug, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Once);
            _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.Log(LogLevel.Trace, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ContainsMessage(v, "[Processed] SetSlot")), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Never);
        }

        private static bool ContainsMessage(object state, string expectedSubstring)
        {
            return state?.ToString().Contains(expectedSubstring) == true;
        }
    }

    // Extension method to make verification easier
    public static class MockLoggerExtensions
    {
        public static void VerifyTrace(this Mock<ILogger<ClusterManager>> mock, string messagePattern, Times times = null)
        {
            times ??= Times.Once();
            mock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Trace, It.IsAny<EventId>(), 
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains(messagePattern)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                times);
        }
    }
}
